# PT Logs

> A personal collection of published learnings, reference notes, and observations by pankaj tajane.

PT Logs is a privacy-first, statically generated website. Only explicitly published content is included.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ptlogs.com/): Introduction and top-level navigation.
- [Uses](https://ptlogs.com/uses/): Hardware and software used for daily work.
- [Colophon](https://ptlogs.com/colophon/): How the site is authored, built, and hosted.

## Published logs

- [Logs](https://ptlogs.com/logs/): Index of published logs.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://ptlogs.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all published pages.
